description: This file defines the Event class in the Goteo project, handling event creation, retrieval, existence checks, and execution of callbacks with database persistence.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class representing an event with methods for creation, retrieval, validation, and execution of associated callbacks, with database interaction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Event instance with specified action and type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by action.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by its ID.

methods.name: getByHash
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by its hash.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance by a specified field and value.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an event with a given hash exists, optionally only succeeded events.

methods.name: encodeAction
methods.description: Encodes an action array into a string or returns the string if already provided.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the event's action and hash, throws exception if a duplicate succeeded event exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the event to the database, validating first.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the event, checking for duplication.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a PHP callback to be associated with the event.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Executes the callback, saves the result, and updates event status accordingly.
